name: HSP_ACCT_SBO
description:
This table contains the balances on the hospital account (HAR). These balances are always populated for Hospital Billing HARs. They are also populated for Professional Billing HARs in service areas using the Enterprise Self-Pay platform.





For legacy mixed hospital accounts the balances are the combined Hospital Billing and Professional Billing transaction balances on each HAR.
